apiDeploymentDescription.defaultValue: [format('{0} Deployment for version {1} and environment {2}', parameters('apiDisplayName'), parameters('apiVersionName'), parameters('environmentName'))]

variables.$fxv#1:
<policies>
    <inbound>
        <base />
        <return-response>
            <set-status code="200" />
            <set-body>@{
                    var random = new Random();
                    double temperature;
                    var format = "Celsius";
                    var descriptions = new[] { "Clear skies", "Partly cloudy", "Overcast", "Rainy" };
                    var city = context.Request.MatchedParameters["city"];
                    switch (city.ToLower())
                    {
                        case "seattle":
                        case "new york city":
                        case "los angeles":
                            format = "Fahrenheit";
                            temperature = random.Next(14, 95) + random.NextDouble();
                            break;
                        default:
                            temperature = random.Next(-5, 35) + random.NextDouble();
                            break;
                    }
                    return new JObject(
                        new JProperty("city", city),
                        new JProperty("temperature", Math.Round(temperature, 1)),
                        new JProperty("temperature_format", format),
                        new JProperty("description", descriptions[random.Next(descriptions.Length)]),
                        new JProperty("humidity", random.Next(20, 100)),
                        new JProperty("wind_speed", Math.Round(random.NextDouble() * 10, 1))
                        ).ToString();
                    }</set-body>
        </return-response>
    </inbound>
    <backend>
        <base />
    </backend>
    <outbound>
        <base />
    </outbound>
    <on-error>
        <base />
    </on-error>
</policies>
